title: Tom Brady said he asked NFL if he could make comeback while owning Raiders: 'They don't like that idea very much'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tom Brady said he asked NFL if he could make comeback while owning Raiders: 'They don't like that idea very much'
sources.description: Tom Brady is "happily retired," but he apparently asked the NFL what it would look like if he wanted to come back.
